propositions: The public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking change (deprecated v0.11.0, removed 2026-08-12) and replaced with rebar.llm.review_plan() and rebar.llm.review_code().

Four CI lanes in the Live External Integration workflow fail with AttributeError: module 'rebar.llm' has no attribute 'review_ticket' because two external test modules (test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py) still call the removed API.
The removal epic's test retarget pass missed these two external modules because they are marked 'external' and excluded from the standard Gerrit Verified gate.

The fix is not a mechanical rename: review_plan() returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT with no top-level findings and cannot satisfy test assertions expecting REVIEW_RESULT with runner/model/findings; both modules must be retargeted to review_code() instead.
Both external test modules must be retargeted to rebar.llm.review_code() with assertions and schema matching that operation's actual result contract (REVIEW_RESULT).
